thread:
taylor: Quick thread - aligning on a migration lane for customers who require slow rollouts and bespoke benchmarks. BigCorp-like asks keep coming; want a repeatable path. Thoughts?

mia: Concrete ask from sales: a slow-roll lane with extended test windows, per-customer anchor sets, and an option to delay auto-upgrades for up to 12 months.

raj: runtime: can do a "migration lane" that wires in per-customer anchor sets and longer canaries, but it increases KV cache fragmentation and monitoring overhead. Need clear limits on concurrent lanes.

olivia: product: propose lanes: fast (default), standard (30d notice), slow (90d notice + 3mo hold opt), and enterprise-hold (paid, up to 12mo). Each lane defines: bench thresholds, canary %/duration, and required comms artifacts.

mia: for benchmarks recommend: latency p95 <= +12% baseline, semantic sim >= 0.97 on anchor, and no more than 2 high-sev regressions in smoke suite. Also require a small customer-provided test corpus.

raj: agree on thresholds but make per-customer similarity overrideable via catalog metadata. Implementation note: add telemetry for held-lane impact on cache hit-rate.

olivia: comms: we'll provide a migration checklist and a template deprecation notice. Sales can request the enterprise-hold SKU during contract renewal.

catalog-bot: created ticket PROD-ONBOARD-881 (migration-lanes + catalog-metadata) https://redwood.app/issue/PROD-ONBOARD-881

taylor: action items: raj -> prototype lane flags + telemetry by next Wed; mia -> draft benchmark + anchor_set guidance; olivia -> pricing tiers and checklist; raj/olivia -> cap concurrent holds per-cluster in infra RFC. reconvene Fri for sign-off.

mia: small note: ensure we capture customer opt-in via API field `pin_hold_tier` so we can report in billing and console.

taylor: perfect, thanks. saving this thread as the record for the migration-lane design decision.
